summary: RMX Industries filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) supplementing its May 14, 2026 report to disclose completion of its acquisition of software-platform IP assets from Apollo Group Enterprises, LLC under an IP purchase agreement dated May 8, 2026. Consideration was 500,000 Class A common shares, restated to reflect a one-for-three reverse split effective July 24, 2026, valued at roughly $3.8 million — about 11.8% of RMX's $32.2 million total assets at December 31, 2025. The US equivalent is an asset-purchase current report; watch share issuance dilution, valuation marks, and any post-split overhang.
